Hey @Adarsh-verma-14, apologies it seems that we cannot deduplicate this feature because it's used k8s.io/apis which cannot depend on apiserver, and also in apiserver which cannot directly depend on pkg/kube_features.go. I've created an issue to track this, only features that are used specifically in apiserver may be defined in the kube_features for apiserver. https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/127160

Unfortunately InPlacePodVerticalScaling is not a candidate, though RetryGenerateName is if you're interested in looking at that.

issue_context.title: InPlacePodVerticalScaling feature duplicate feature definition
issue_context.body:
The InPlacePodVerticalScaling feature is duplicated in both https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/pkg/features/kube_features.go#L922-L928 and https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/staging/src/k8s.io/apiserver/pkg/features/kube_features.go#L287-L292.

Traditionally pkg/features should inherit from apiserver features as defined here: https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/pkg/features/kube_features.go#L1245-L1256 to prevent duplication and drift.

/cc @vinaykul @jpbetz

@Jefftree , I have worked on it but I am  facing some issue
when I remove  the feature flag definition from `pkg/features/kube_features.go` causes errors in the source code because many parts of the code are still using it

if i only replace this line `InPlacePodVerticalScaling: {Default: false, PreRelease: featuregate.Alpha}`, with `genericfeatures.InPlacePodVerticalScaling: {Default: false, PreRelease: featuregate.Alpha},` in pkg/features/kube_features.go then is there duplication removed or not ?

Yes it is removed. You can also remove the definition in `pkg/features/kube_features.go`. If anything else in the code references the `InPlacePodVerticalScaling` variable from `pkg/features/kube_features.go` instead of the one from genericfeatures, they will also need to be updated.

@Jefftree, you mean like for example this snippet code https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/pkg/api/pod/util.go#L657 using 
`InPlacePodVerticalScaling` variable from pkg/features/kube_features.go then I need to replace with `genericfeatures.InPlacePodVerticalScaling` instead of `features.InPlacePodVerticalScaling`.

first one is I removed feature flag definition  from `pkg/features/kube_feature.go` for InPlacePodVerticalScaling and inherit pkg/feature from `apiserver` traditionally as suggested
second one is which part of source code references the `InPlacePodVerticalScaling` variable from `pkg/features/kube_features.go` is also updated using inherit from apiserver.
